name: Fallen Moonstone
summary: At Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale, night elves draw stones of healing from the water. Blessed by the moon, Fallen Moonstone can restore strength when frailty runs deep.

sections.title: Gifts of the Night Sky
sections.body: Southeast of Astranaar, Fallen Sky Lake once held many Fallen Moonstones along its shores and shallows. Night elves prized their healing when ordinary remedies failed. But corrupt Shadethicket bog beasts overran the lake, led by a Shadethicket Oracle. The Oracle hoarded every stone it found on a small island at the lake’s center, leaving the local Kaldorei without a vital source of healing.

sections.title: A Father's Salvation
sections.body: In Astranaar, young Relara Whitemoon fell gravely ill. Ordinary treatments broke her fever, yet left her faded and near death. Only a few breaths remained. Her father, Pelturas Whitemoon, knew a moonstone’s concentrated power could restore her failing strength. A stone taken from the Shadethicket Oracle’s hoard gave Relara the strength to live.

faq.answer: Fallen Moonstone shines with magic from Fallen Sky Lake in Ashenvale. Its sacred lunar energy can restore strength to night elves weakened by severe frailty.
Fallen Moonstones come from Fallen Sky Lake, southeast of Astranaar in Ashenvale. They once lay across the lake bed, but the hostile Shadethicket bog beasts gathered them on a central island.

faq.q: Who possesses the moonstones at Fallen Sky Lake?
faq.answer: The Shadethicket Oracle hoarded Fallen Moonstones on an island in the center of Fallen Sky Lake. The Oracle leads the corrupted bog beasts there.

faq.q: Why does Pelturas Whitemoon need a Fallen Moonstone?
faq.answer: Pelturas Whitemoon needs a Fallen Moonstone to save his young daughter, Relara. She survived a debilitating fever but remained critically frail, and he knew the stone’s magic could restore her strength.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, relics tied to Elune’s radiance are sacred instruments of preservation. They can bring divine healing when mortal medicine fails.
Devotees of the Sisterhood of Elune see the stones’ lunar glow as a sign of healing grace.
